address: 3645 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: VIP
zones.description: VIP is the closest seating tier, including the center-front area and side blocks nearest the stage.

zones.label: Premium
zones.description: Premium is the Sweet Spot / Our Pick: directly behind VIP with enough proximity for the mind-reading to feel personal without paying the top tier.

zones.label: General Admission
zones.description: General Admission sits behind Premium and along the outer room, giving you a solid value view in this compact showroom.

zones.label: GA Rear
zones.description: GA Rear is the farthest value tier. The room is compact, so it still keeps the stage readable while emphasizing price over proximity.
